data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of $8.4m (2014: favourable run off deviation of $169.1m) was experienced during the year in respect of various lines of business. Most significantly releases within aviation ($7.2m), marine ($5.4m), liability ($10.7m) where offset by increases in reinsurance ($20.2m). This is mainly due to a reduction in the ultimate loss estimates.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a small favourable prior-accident-year development in 2015, with a reported prior accident year release of $8.4m. The release was attributed to a reduction in ultimate loss estimates and comprised releases in aviation, marine and liability, partly offset by increases in reinsurance reserves. Overall the movement represents only a minor release relative to opening gross claims outstanding (approximately -0.21%).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement ($8.4m release) is taken from the Movement in prior year's provision note (explicitly stated) but the note does not explicitly label the $8.4m as gross vs net; it is presented as a 'run off deviation'. Opening claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet comparative column (explicit). All monetary values in the report are shown in $000's and have been converted to millions for this output.
